import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    index = 0
    t = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    
    results = []
    
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        tags = list(map(int, data[index:index + n]))
        index += n
        
        tag_count = defaultdict(list)
        for i, tag in enumerate(tags):
            tag_count[tag].append(i)
        
        if any(len(indices) > 2 for indices in tag_count.values()):
            results.append(-1)
            continue
        
        if any(len(indices) == 2 and abs(indices[1] - indices[0]) == 1 for indices in tag_count.values()):
            results.append(1)
            continue
        
        if any(len(indices) == 2 for indices in tag_count.values()):
            results.append(2)
            continue
        
        results.append(0)
    
    for result in results:
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
